elementValueMap.StatusTodoClaroPreSalesValidation:
=IF(
  OR(
    SUBSTRING(%ResponseStatusTodoClaro:ConsultAgeAndCustomerSegmentation:codSegmento%, 1, 2) = "1",
    SUBSTRING(%ResponseStatusTodoClaro:ConsultAgeAndCustomerSegmentation:codSegmento%, 1, 2) = "5"
  ),
  "No Potencial",
  IF(
    OR(
      SUBSTRING(%ResponseStatusTodoClaro:ConsultAgeAndCustomerSegmentation:codSegmento%, 1, 2) = "3",
      SUBSTRING(%ResponseStatusTodoClaro:ConsultAgeAndCustomerSegmentation:codSegmento%, 1, 2) = "4"
    ),
    "Todo Claro",
    IF(
      SUBSTRING(%ResponseStatusTodoClaro:ConsultAgeAndCustomerSegmentation:codSegmento%, 1, 2) = "2",
      "Potencial",
      ""
    )
  )
)
